parameters.description:
`msg-to-viber` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Viber destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Viber destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Viber destinations bound per enrollment.

Create a Viber Bot through the Viber Developers portal and copy the bot authentication token it gives you into VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN. Viber bots can only message users who have subscribed to them first, so have the intended recipient message or subscribe to your bot, then capture their receiver ID from the resulting webhook callback and set it as VIBER_RECEIVER.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"receiver":"${ customer_secrets.VIBER_RECEIVER }","type":"text","text":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: {"receiver":"${ customer_secrets.{{ params.receiver_secret }} }","type":"text","text":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Viber destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Viber Bot API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Viber destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

auth_token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN value (same format as VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN)

receiver_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VIBER_RECEIVER value (same format as VIBER_RECEIVER)
